consumer: The engine's active input loop reading the NPC interaction menu (game::npc_menu's uilist::query) and the subsequent trade-window selection, which asks the player to interactively choose which items to give and take and confirm the exchange.
scope: The real active input loop/menu mechanism driving the NPC menu selection and the trade window's per-item give/take confirmation; not a passive carried-items or ground-items snapshot.
decisive_source: src/game.cpp::game::npc_menu builds a uilist (Talk/Swap/Push/...) and calls amenu.query(), the interactive entry point into NPC interaction including the trade transaction, which is answered through the real input loop rather than a computed value or a snapshot.
divergence: The backend reports a completed trade (items moved between avatar and NPC inventories) without the engine's trade menu ever being queried/confirmed, so the NPC's gold/credit balance and any haggle/relationship effects are never applied and the avatar ends up with items it never legitimately acquired.
